subject: Post-call: procurement checklist & target timeline for vendor onboarding
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Marsh <olivia@greenbridge.io>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: procurement checklist & next steps

Hi Olivia — thanks for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single plan to share with your stakeholders.

Summary from today's discovery
- Primary evaluation criteria: latency under 250ms p95 for short chat flows, end-to-end cost per 1M tokens, and predictable SLAs for enterprise workloads.
- Economic buyer: Tom Ellis (CFO) — asked for total cost of ownership and billing cadence.
- Security/legal: will need SOC 2 Type II evidence, DPA + standard data processing language, and confirmation on data residency (US).
- Procurement: GreenBridge requires supplier registration (vendor form + W9) and PO before first invoice; standard payment term conversation below.

Procurement/contract items we committed to deliver
1) Completed vendor questionnaire (attached: vendor_questionnaire.pdf)
2) Draft MSA with our suggested redlines (attached: redlined_MSA_draft.docx)
3) Pricing snapshot for pilot/production tiers (attached: pricing_snapshot.xlsx)
4) SOC2 report (we've attached a redacted version; full multipage available on request once NDA/DPA in place)

Target timeline (mutual action plan suggestion)
- 8/12: GreenBridge to share supplier registration link + primary procurement contact
- 8/18: Legal/Procurement review completed (questions raised)
- 8/25: Signed MSA and PO issued (target)
- 9/06: Pilot environment provisioned and kickoff

Open questions for GreenBridge
- Can you confirm the billing entity name and TIN for the PO?
- Is 30 days net acceptable for invoices, or do you require 45 days net?
- Do you have any additional compliance docs beyond SOC2 (e.g., penetration test reports)?

Next steps from our side
- I'll upload the questionnaire and MSA to the Drive link and send a calendar invite for a short alignment meeting with Tom + Legal.
- Laura will coordinate with security to get the SOC2 summary + contacts.

Thanks again — happy to hop back on a quick call to walk Tom and Legal through the pricing and SLA items. Proposed slots: Thu 8/13 (10–11am PT) or Fri 8/14 (2–3pm PT).

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: vendor_questionnaire.pdf, redlined_MSA_draft.docx, pricing_snapshot.xlsx

Thanks for the thorough recap, Sergio — and good meeting earlier.

Quick clarifications from procurement side:
- I'm adding our procurement inbox (procurement@greenbridge.io) to this thread — they'll manage vendor registration.
- We will require a supplier registration form + W9 and two customer references for vendor onboarding. Can you provide two references (name, company, contact) who can speak to reliability and security?
- Billing entity: GreenBridge Health, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789) — please confirm your invoicing entity and the address you will put on the PO.
- Payment terms: standard is 45 days net for suppliers, but exceptions can be made for strategic partners. Please indicate if Redwood can accommodate 45 days, or whether you prefer 30 days net.

Legal note: I copied Tom and he indicated Legal will want to review the redlined MSA and DPA. Tom — are you available for a 30-minute call Thursday morning to review?

I'll pull the supplier registration link and send it by EOD tomorrow.

—Olivia
